title: FanDuel's new NFL season offering: more choice, more control
body_markdown:
**FanDuel Rewards Club**


FanDuel Rewards Club is new to Sportsbook, but not new to FanDuel: it extends a model that already worked on FanDuel Casino, rebuilt for how sports fans actually play. According to **Aman Gupta, FanDuel's Sportsbook Growth Senior Vice President** , it comes down to three things: transparency, choice and predictability, so customers know when rewards are coming, understand how they're earning them, and can pick the benefit that matters most to them.


FanDuel's boosts and bonuses have grown over the years, and along the way they've ended up spread across different parts of the app, easy to miss if you're not checking in daily. Rewards Club brings daily rewards, tier status and progress together in one place, with levels tied to each customer's existing level of play.


The program also adds a new weekly "Choose Your Reward" feature, live every Monday, letting eligible customers pick the benefit that fits how they play: a Deposit Match, Bet Reset Token, Bonus Bet or Profit Boost Token. Layered on top are milestone-driven Challenges and Mystery Reward Boxes that reveal a surprise token when a customer levels up. During beta testing, more than 80% of surveyed customers said Rewards Club improved their FanDuel experience.


The choice-first design also ties into FanDuel's Play with a Plan initiative, which encourages customers to set a budget and think ahead about how they play. **Gupta frames the launch as a starting point** : "This is the start of the journey, not the end of the journey."
